ORTRIO Limited, a subsidiary of AKSID Corporation Limited, is the exclusive distribution partner for a leading manufacturer of specialty water treatment chemicals in Bangladesh. This role is ideal for a technically proficient sales professional eager to excel in a high-growth, B2B technical sales environment.
